## Problem

What is hard or impossible today? Which stage of the loop is affected (capture, merge, audit, enrich, feedback, iteration, upload)?

## Proposed change

Describe the behaviour you want. If it is a new quality check, say whether it should be `drop`, `review`, or `not_checked` when its preconditions are missing.

## Additional context

Datasets, papers, or hardware this relates to.
